objective: Build the first half of the assessment's P3 slice on the loaded /property overview, following docs/design/ui-cleanup/P1-VISUAL-STATE-SPEC.md section 5.3 (and its vocabulary section 2, tokens section 3, preservation checklist section 7, cross-cutting section 8, copy samples section 9): (1) ONE exception strip above the overview (the A04 row) that names only ACTIVE issues - identity mismatch, unresolved conflict, critical missing input, stale source, incomplete assessment - each with its critical field names and the effect it blocks, replacing today's separate conflict / missing-input alerts WITHOUT losing their links or wording meaning (build it as a new component OverviewExceptionStrip.tsx); (2) the two-column overview canvas on desktop (site map/context + the limit matrix), stacking on phones; (3) city-record FAR and evaluated (draft) FAR as DISTINCT rows, the cap row keeping 'FAR only - buildable envelope not assessed' AND showing its readable per-cap coverage status beside the number (DB-083 e; the M5-T080 HJ-4 correction); 'Unknown' stays the word, never a blank or dash; (4) the shell's environment + professional-review disclosure visible at phone width on LOADED workspace surfaces too (today .architect-environment and the nav footnote are display:none at <=700px - DB-087 g / DISC-P2-1). business_reason: The owner asked for a more visually explanatory product (D-086). The overview is the main analysis screen: one clear 'what blocks reliance' strip and an honest limit matrix are the biggest clarity win after the search/confirm slice.
inputs: PRODUCER MODE (binding): you are an orchestrator-dispatched subagent producer working ONLY inside your task worktree (named in the dispatch). Commit your work there as ONE commit and report its sha. Never touch the primary checkout, the ledger, or any path outside allowed_paths.
